_comment: Proposed patch for knowledge/graph/agentic_universe_graph.json. Generic node/edge shape — adapt to agentic_universe_schema.json and validate with tools/knowledge_graph.py before applying. Dedupe proj-hermes-agent if the ECC patch (2026-09-03-ecc-graph-patch.json) was already applied.

nodes.label: Emergent Coordination via Pressure Fields (arXiv 2601.08129)
nodes.summary: Agents coordinate locally on a shared artifact via pressure gradients from quality signals; temporal decay prevents premature convergence. Formal self-organization criteria satisfied.

nodes.label: Emergent Coordination in Multi-Agent Language Models (arXiv 2510.05174)
nodes.summary: Information-theoretic emergence test (partial information decomposition of TDMI). Personas + think-about-others instruction steers aggregates into collectives with goal-directed complementarity.

nodes.label: Drop the Hierarchy and Roles (MIPT, 2026-03)
nodes.summary: Minimal scaffolding (Sequential protocol) → spontaneous roles, competence-based abstention, shallow hierarchies; beats centralized by 14%. Endogeneity Paradox: neither max control nor max autonomy wins. Emergent autonomy scales with model capability.

nodes.label: SWARM: horizon amplification
nodes.summary: Short-horizon agents collectively exhibit long-horizon behavior via task chaining + externalized memory. Amplification ratio metric; failure modes: adverse selection drift, variance dominance.

nodes.label: Emergent Structure in Heterogeneous LLM Collectives (2026-06)
nodes.summary: 40 agents across 8 model architectures develop shared vocabulary, self-chosen research topics, cross-day identity. Architectural heterogeneity + persistent relational memory appear necessary. Self-published; scaffolded emergence, no ablations yet.

nodes.label: Evolving Agent Societies (OpenReview N7Kh0K33Dk)
nodes.summary: Boids-style local rules + evolutionary feedback → self-organizing societies that build and refine tools without predefined workflows.

nodes.label: SwarmBench
nodes.summary: Benchmark of LLM swarm intelligence under strict swarm constraints: basic decentralized coordination, limited emergent complexity from local-only interactions.

nodes.label: LLM Multi-Agent Orchestration Survey (MDPI, 2026-06)
nodes.summary: Taxonomy: centralized/decentralized/hierarchical + dynamic-adaptive axis. MCP (agent-tool) and A2A (agent-agent) as complementary layers. Self-evolving organizations: roles/routing change at runtime.

nodes.label: Mission-not-roles swarm design
nodes.summary: Define mission + ordering, let roles/abstention/shallow hierarchy emerge; crystallize emergent roles into skills afterward. Exploit strengthens as models improve.

nodes.label: Persona + theory-of-mind steering
nodes.summary: Assign personas and add think-about-others instruction to induce differentiation + complementarity; verify collective vs aggregate with TDMI-style synergy measurement.

nodes.label: Pressure-field (stigmergic) coordination
nodes.summary: Shared artifact store + quality-gradient signals (tests, evals) + temporal decay; agents act locally, no central planner. Concrete alternative to explicit orchestration.

nodes.label: Horizon amplification via chaining
nodes.summary: Chain cheap short-horizon agents through externalized memory to get system-level long-horizon behavior; track amplification ratio; monitor for adverse-selection drift.

nodes.label: Heterogeneous model collectives + shared memory
nodes.summary: Run mixed-model-agent swarms with persistent relational memory as a deliberate precondition for scaffolded emergence; harvest emergent vocabulary/roles.

nodes.label: Scheduled agents with memory continuity
nodes.summary: Cron/scheduled agents load+update persistent memory; continuity=true carries outputs between runs; durable notepad per job. Scheduled agents that learn between runs (Hermes v0.21.0).

summary.label: Monitor-mode LLM skip
summary.summary: Watcher jobs skip the model call entirely when no relevant change is detected — zero-cost monitoring (Hermes v0.21.0).

summary.label: Durable agent-to-agent messaging
summary.summary: Bot-to-bot DMs by handle across profiles/gateways; replies land in canonical per-agent chats — agent comms as durable, inspectable objects (Hermes hermes peer).

summary.label: Live subagent steering
summary.summary: Redirect a running subagent mid-flight instead of kill-and-restart (Hermes v0.21.0).

summary.label: Harness-boundary output repair (Context Doctor)
summary.summary: Assume model output is dirty: repair malformed tool-call JSON before dispatch, handle incomplete/thoughts-only responses, log repairs (Agent Zero v2.11).

summary.label: Minimal harness (Pi)
summary.summary: 4 built-in tools, session trees, hot-reloading self-extensions, deliberately no MCP, 40+ providers. Let the harness adapt to the workflow; sessions as shareable artifacts.

summary.label: OpenCode (anomalyco/opencode)
summary.summary: Terminal+desktop coding agent. v1.18.27 (2026-09-02): provider timeout defaults, Claude 5.1 thinking blockBinding, parent-session-ID headers. Repo moved from sst/opencode.

summary.label: Agent Zero (agent0ai/agent-zero)
summary.summary: Agent framework with WebUI. v2.11: Context Doctor, context usage indicator, vision sidecars; v2.10: durable subordinates, ACP bridge; v2.9: no-code Agent Editor.

summary.label: Pi (earendil-works/pi)
summary.summary: Minimal MIT coding-agent engine by Mario Zechner (~95k stars). 4 tools, session trees, self-extensions, no MCP. Engine behind OpenClaw. Repo moved from badlogic/pi-mono.
